Aparatas su varikliu; ji dirba už žmones.

In the factory there are many new machines.

Mašina, kuri veža žmogų už pinigus.

To the station we travel by taxi.

Didelė mašina, kuri veža daug žmonių mieste.

To work I travel by bus.

Autobusas, kuris važiuoja elektra, o ne benzinu.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A bus that travels on electricity, not on petrol.
In Vilnius we travel by trolley bus.

Jis skrenda danguje ir veža žmones į kitas šalis.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: It flies in the sky and carries people to other countries.
By airplane we fly to London.

Ilga mašina, kuri veža žmones geležinkeliu.

To Kaunas we travel by train.

Jis plaukia jūra ir veža žmones.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: It sails on the sea and carries people.
By ship we sail to the island.

In the train we see the inspector.

During the inspection we show tickets.

Žiūrėti, ar žmogus turi bilietą ir dokumentus.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To look at whether a person has a ticket and documents.
The inspector checks tickets in the bus.

Didelis pastatas, kur laukiame traukinio ar autobuso.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A big building where we wait for a train or a bus.
We meet by the station.

Lagaminai ir krepšiai, kuriuos imame į kelionę.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: Suitcases and bags that we take on a journey.
The baggage we carry into the train.

Vieta gatvėje, kur laukiame autobuso.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place on the street where we wait for the bus.
By the stop stand many people.

Vieta prie jūros, kur stovi laivai.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place by the sea where ships stand.
In the Klaipėda port there are big ships.

Traukinio dalis, kurioje sėdi žmonės.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A part of the train in which people sit.
Our seats are in the third carriage.

Juo važiuoja automobiliai tarp miestų.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: Along it cars travel between cities.
Along this road travel many cars.

Juo važiuoja traukiniai iš miesto į miestą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: Along it trains travel from city to city.
Along the new railway travel fast trains.

Vieta stotyje, kur laukiame traukinio.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place in the station where we wait for the train.
The train stands by the second platform.

Tai, ką norime žinoti apie kelionę ar reisą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: That which we want to know about a journey or a flight.
At the station we ask for information.

Lėktuvo ar autobuso kelionė su savo numeriu ir laiku.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: An airplane's or a bus's journey with its own number and time.
We wait for our flight.

Oro uoste prieš kelionę parodyti pasą ir atiduoti bagažą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: At the airport before the journey to show a passport and hand over the baggage.
The passengers check in at the airport.

Kai keleiviai oro uoste rodo pasą ir atiduoda bagažą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: When passengers at the airport show a passport and hand over the baggage.
Before the journey we go to the check-in.

Kai traukinys ar lėktuvas jau yra vietoje.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: When the train or the airplane is already in place.
We wait for the airplane's arrival.

Kai traukinys ar lėktuvas pradeda kelionę.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: When the train or the airplane begins the journey.
At the station we see the departure time.

Mokėti pinigus ir gauti daiktą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To pay money and get a thing.
I buy a ticket for the train.

Vieta, kur duodame eurus ir gauname dolerius.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place where we give euros and get dollars.
In the exchange we get dollars for euros.

Duoti vieną daiktą ir gauti kitą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To give one thing and get another.
I change euros into dollars.

Greitas dviratis su varikliu.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A fast bicycle with an engine.
A young man rides a motorcycle.

Žmogus, kuris vairuoja automobilį ar autobusą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A person who drives a car or a bus.
We talk with the driver.

Dokumentas, kuris rodo, kad gali vairuoti automobilį.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A document that shows that you can drive a car.
The policeman looks at my licence.

Vaikščioti kojomis, o ne važiuoti mašina.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To go on foot, and not to travel by car.
To school we go together.

Kelio dalis, kur eina žmonės.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A part of the road where people walk.
The children walk on the sidewalk.

Kelias per upę ar per geležinkelį.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A road across a river or across a railway.
Cars travel across the bridge.

Vieta, kur susitinka du keliai.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place where two roads meet.
By the junction there is a traffic light.

Prie kelio jis rodo raudoną, geltoną ir žalią spalvą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: By the road it shows a red, yellow and green colour.
We wait by the traffic light.

Balta vieta ant kelio žmonėms, ne mašinoms.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A white place on the road for people, not for cars.
By the crossing stands a car.

Vieta, kur susitinka dvi namo sienos arba dvi gatvės.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A place where two walls of a house or two streets meet.
The shop is at the street corner.

Važiuoti į dešinę ar į kairę.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To travel to the right or to the left.
By the traffic light we turn to the right.

Jis stovi prie kelio ir rodo, kur važiuoti.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: It stands by the road and shows where to travel.
The driver sees the road sign.

Žmonės, kurie ieško vagių ir padeda žmonėms.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: People who look for thieves and help people.
On the road we see a police car.

Pinigai, kuriuos mokame, kai padarome klaidą kelyje.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: Money that we pay when we make a mistake on the road.
The driver got a big fine.

Duoti pinigus už daiktą ar darbą.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: To give money for a thing or work.
I pay for the ticket with money.

Popierius, kuriame matome miestus ir kelius.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A paper on which we see cities and roads.
On the journey we need a map.

Ilgis kelyje; nuo Vilniaus iki Kauno jų yra daug.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A length on the road; from Vilnius to Kaunas there are many of them.
To the city there are a few kilometres.

Ilgis, kuriuo sakome, koks ilgas ar aukštas daiktas.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A length by which we say how long or tall a thing is.
Nuo lango iki durų yra du metrai.
From the window to the door there are two metres.

Trumpa kelionė po miestą ar muziejų.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A short journey around a city or a museum.
Tomorrow we go on an excursion.

Žmogus, kuris keliauja po kitas šalis ir jas apžiūri.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A person who travels around other countries and looks at them.
In the old town there are many tourists.

Žmogus, kuris rodo miestą ir pasakoja apie jį.
A machine with wheels; with it we travel: A person who shows the city and tells about it.
In the museum we listen to the guide.
